items.mainDefect: The resize loop checks a stale file-descriptor size after optimization replaces the file, causing unnecessary resize passes.

secondary.defect: Upload.create_for receives the stale size and records a filesize that does not match the stored image.
FastImage may read the orphaned file descriptor and record dimensions that do not match the stored image.

items.mainDefect: The hardcoded client upload cap rejects attachments above 10MB even when the configured attachment limit permits them.

secondary.defect: The upload rejection message reports a hardcoded 10MB limit instead of the configured limit.

items.mainDefect: The hardcoded client upload gate disagrees with the configured attachment limit enforced by the server.

secondary.defect: The 413 handler reports a hardcoded 10MB limit instead of the limit actually enforced.

items.mainDefect: Five fixed resize passes do not guarantee the promised reduction to the allowed upload size.

secondary.defect: The loop ignores conversion failures returned as false and continues without shrinking the file.

items.mainDefect: Five fixed 80% resize passes can leave an image above the configured size limit.

secondary.defect: The loop ignores downsize returning false, wasting all five attempts before submitting the unchanged file.

items.mainDefect: The hardcoded client upload cap rejects images above 10MB even when the configured image limit permits them.

secondary.defect: The 413 handler hardcodes the reported limit to 10MB instead of using the configured limit.
The URL download cap is fixed at 10MB even when the configured image limit is higher.
